WITH "parsed_payments" AS (
  SELECT
    "customer_id",
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', COALESCE(TRY_TO_DATE("payment_date", 'YYYYMMDD'), TRY_TO_DATE(SUBSTR("payment_date", 1, 10), 'YYYY-MM-DD'))) AS "payment_month",
    "amount"
  FROM SQLITE_SAKILA.SQLITE_SAKILA.PAYMENT
  WHERE COALESCE(TRY_TO_DATE("payment_date", 'YYYYMMDD'), TRY_TO_DATE(SUBSTR("payment_date", 1, 10), 'YYYY-MM-DD')) IS NOT NULL
),
"monthly_totals" AS (
  SELECT
    "customer_id",
    "payment_month",
    SUM("amount") AS "monthly_payment_amount"
  FROM "parsed_payments"
  GROUP BY
    "customer_id",
    "payment_month"
),
"monthly_changes" AS (
  SELECT
    "customer_id",
    "payment_month",
    ABS("monthly_payment_amount" - LAG("monthly_payment_amount") OVER (PARTITION BY "customer_id" ORDER BY "payment_month")) AS "monthly_change_in_payment_amount"
  FROM "monthly_totals"
),
"average_changes" AS (
  SELECT
    "customer_id",
    AVG("monthly_change_in_payment_amount") AS "average_monthly_change"
  FROM "monthly_changes"
  WHERE "monthly_change_in_payment_amount" IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY "customer_id"
),
"ranked_customers" AS (
  SELECT
    "customer_id",
    "average_monthly_change"
  FROM "average_changes"
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY "average_monthly_change" DESC NULLS LAST, "customer_id" ASC) = 1
)
SELECT
  "c"."first_name" || ' ' || "c"."last_name" AS "full_name"
FROM "ranked_customers" AS "r"
JOIN SQLITE_SAKILA.SQLITE_SAKILA.CUSTOMER AS "c"
  ON "r"."customer_id" = "c"."customer_id"
ORDER BY
  "r"."average_monthly_change" DESC NULLS LAST,
  "c"."customer_id" ASC;
